reason: Repo rate cut of 25 basis points announced 2026-09-19 11:04. The statutory ceiling moves from 28.00% to 27.45% and 1 104 cells on 2026-09-A are in breach.
_comment: A patch is a VERSION, not an edit. 2026-09-A stays exactly as it was; applications in flight at 14:00 complete on it (acceptance criterion 10) because the generation pointer is read once per invocation. The patch path produces the same validation artefact as a full refresh -- see `validation` below -- which is card-validation rule 5.

applications_priced_from_breached_cells._comment: Zero because the ceiling artefact is itself effective-dated and its own effective_from is the gazette timestamp, so `at_or_below_statutory_ceiling` was already failing every read from 11:04 and the flow FAILED LOUDLY rather than lending at an unlawful rate (5.7a). The two-hour window is for restoring service, not for containing a breach.
